Keep a finite verb (including auxiliaries or copulas) together with its immediately following complement when that complement starts with a numeral (digits), an opening parenthesis '(', a preposition (in, on, at, to, for, from, by, of, with, toward, towards), or a capitalized token: bind the verb plus the contiguous complement tokens as one segment.
